# NoInfer candidate-boundary fixtures

This independent TypeScript 5.9.3 matrix freezes 94 authored forms under three
strict target/module/library profiles: 282 observations, 153 accepted declaration
inventories / 159 files, 306 isolated declaration consumers and six executions.
Positive and negative programs cover argument/context evidence, aliases/imports,
nested structural positions, defaults/constraints, callbacks/overloads,
conditional infer, keyof, rest packs, materialized results and owner shadows.

The [fixed scope and acceptance](../../../../../development/browser_core/phase-18-bluets/NOINFER_FOLLOWUP.md)
retain exact frozen hashes and the previous accepted compiler replay. Reference
bytes were recorded before production changes. The ordinary Rust public-boundary
test compares all verdicts, full primary/related diagnostics, UTF-16 positions,
complete declaration inventories and rejected-project publication. The pinned
oracle also checks source-free consumers, selected-edition syntax and execution.
Separate BlueTS owner/budget controls do not enlarge the Native denominator.

`keyof-diagnostics.json` supplies four additional independently recorded
ES2022/CommonJS regressions. Ordinary and barrier-wrapped keys retain the named
owner's diagnostic identity. A separate pinned verifier replays all four Native
and BlueTS builds, including exact diagnostics and rejected publication. These
assertions extend global accounting while the original 282-case benchmark and
its baseline remain unchanged.
